evidence.section: 3.3 Microstructure of Al–5Cu–1.5Ni–xV alloy after T6 heat treatment
evidence.quote: After T6 heat treatment, the original fine Al3(Ni, Cu)2 network structure of the as-cast alloy is transformed into many independent elliptic or spherical coarse particles with smooth edges
the a-Al dendrite structure of the alloy also becomes signiﬁcantly coarser after heat treatment
The coarse Al–Al2Cu eutectic cells were replaced by the ﬁnely dispersed h0-Al2Cu particles (200–300 nm) after heat treatment
The network skeleton structure and ﬁshbone Al 3(Ni, Cu) 2 phase are continuously distributed along a-Al interdendritic or grain boundaries.
